additional_info.subject: RE: ID0408373-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / PD 170001307] PaymentTerminalUnreachable_PZx CRM:00921001568
additional_info.body:
Hello,
The charger displayed "
Out of Order
" when we selected the terminal option on the screen.
On TMS, it showed "Terminal locked
So I created a ticket to CCV:
CCV then instructed us to delete the transactions. After doing so, they advised us to restart the terminal and attempt the commissioning again. We followed all their instructions, but the issue persists: the terminal didn’t respond to our actions, and on TS3, the error "
System malfunction
" appeared.
After performing all the actions, they checked their system and informed me that the terminal is "
Out of Order”
.
If you require any additional information, feel free to reach out.
Best regard,
